name: 评论邮件通知
description: 订阅 rice.comments 的评论事件，用自实现的 SMTP 客户端异步发送「新评论」「回复」「审核结果」三类通知邮件：发信在插件内部队列中进行，不阻塞评论提交与审核。
author: ccrice

description.zh-CN: 决定哪些事件向谁发信。修改后需重启服务生效；SMTP 密码只从环境变量 RICE_MAIL_PASSWORD 读取，不在此处配置。
description.en: Which events notify whom. A restart is required after changes; the SMTP password is read from the RICE_MAIL_PASSWORD environment variable only.

description.zh-CN: 有访客提交评论时，向下方「站长收件人」发信（逐封单发，收件人之间互相看不到）
description.en: Send one email per recipient below when a visitor submits a comment

description.zh-CN: 可填多个邮箱；留空则不发新评论通知
description.en: One or more emails; leave empty to disable the new-comment notification

description.zh-CN: 「仅已公开」只在评论直接通过审核时通知；「全部」会把垃圾评论也发给你
description.en: “Published only” notifies only when a comment is approved immediately; “All” also forwards spam

description.zh-CN: 仅在该回复「最终公开」后发送；被回复者没有留邮箱、或就是他本人、或就是站长收件人时跳过
description.en: Sent only once the reply is published; skipped when the parent has no email, is the replier, or is an admin recipient

label.zh-CN: 评论公开时通知评论者

description.zh-CN: 评论从待审变为公开时，向评论者本人发一封「你的评论已发布」
description.en: Send “your comment is live” to the author when a pending comment gets approved

label.zh-CN: 判为垃圾时也通知评论者

description.zh-CN: 默认关闭：向未验证的地址回信容易被用于探测邮箱有效性，也会给垃圾发送者反馈信号
description.en: Off by default: replying to unverified addresses can be abused for address probing

label.zh-CN: 站长通知可直接回复评论者
label.en: Reply-To the commenter in admin mail

description.zh-CN: 开启后站长通知邮件的 Reply-To 设为评论者邮箱（评论者未填邮箱或已关闭时不生效）
description.en: When on, the admin notification uses the commenter email as Reply-To

description.zh-CN: SMTP 连接参数。密码不在这里：请在服务端环境变量里设置 RICE_MAIL_PASSWORD。修改后需重启服务生效。
description.en: SMTP connection. The password is not here: set RICE_MAIL_PASSWORD in the server environment. A restart is required after changes.

description.zh-CN: 例如 smtp.example.com
description.en: e.g. smtp.example.com

description.zh-CN: 隐式 TLS 常用 465，STARTTLS 常用 587
description.en: 465 for implicit TLS, 587 for STARTTLS

description.zh-CN: 「隐式 TLS」= 连接即加密；「STARTTLS」= 明文连接后升级加密；「不加密」仅建议内网中继
description.en: Implicit TLS connects encrypted; STARTTLS upgrades after a plain greeting

description.zh-CN: 留空表示不认证；可用环境变量 RICE_MAIL_USER 覆盖此项
description.en: Empty means no authentication; RICE_MAIL_USER overrides this value

description.zh-CN: 必填；多数服务商要求它与认证账号同域，否则会被拒收
description.en: Required; most providers require it to match the authenticated account domain

description.zh-CN: 留空则使用站点标题
description.en: Falls back to the site title when empty

description.zh-CN: 可选。当通知邮件没有更合适的回复地址时使用它
description.en: Optional. Used when a notification has no better reply address

description.zh-CN: 连接与每次等待服务器应答的上限
description.en: Upper bound for connecting and each server reply

description.zh-CN: 超出上限的任务延后投递，避免被邮件服务商限流
description.en: Tasks above the limit are deferred to avoid provider throttling

description.zh-CN: 留空即使用内置默认模板。推荐在后台「评论邮件 → 邮件模板」里编辑：那里可以点选插入变量、实时预览并试发。可用变量见该页列的清单；写错变量名会原样保留在邮件里并在页面上告警。保存后需重启服务生效。
description.en: Leave a field empty to use the built-in template. Editing from the dedicated “Comment mail → Mail templates” page is recommended: it offers variable insertion, live preview and a test send. A restart is required after saving.

description.zh-CN: 可用变量：{{siteTitle}} {{statusShort}} {{postTitle}}
description.en: Variables: {{siteTitle}} {{statusShort}} {{postTitle}}

label.zh-CN: 新评论 → 站长：HTML 正文

description.zh-CN: 常用变量：{{postTitle}} {{authorName}} {{authorEmail}} {{content}} {{commentUrl}} {{adminUrl}}
description.en: Common variables: {{postTitle}} {{authorName}} {{content}} {{commentUrl}} {{adminUrl}}

description.zh-CN: 可用变量：{{siteTitle}} {{authorName}} {{postTitle}}
description.en: Variables: {{siteTitle}} {{authorName}} {{postTitle}}

description.en: Common variables: {{parentAuthorName}} {{authorName}} {{content}} {{commentUrl}}

description.en: Variables: {{siteTitle}} {{postTitle}}

description.en: Common variables: {{postTitle}} {{status}} {{contentExcerpt}}
